findings.text: Scheduler domain repartitioning is serialized through the domains mutex with the substantive update delegated to the locked operation.
Wait queue head initialization establishes a usable empty queue by preparing its lock with caller supplied dependency identity and preparing its list anchor.

Queue membership control offers plain insertion with exclusivity cleared, exclusive tail insertion, priority insertion, conditional priority exclusive insertion with busy refusal when a priority waiter already leads a nonempty queue, and removal.

Wake notification is available as current CPU affinity wake, caller locked wake with count or key, lock acquiring synchronous keyed wake tolerant of absence, locked synchronous keyed wake, unkeyed synchronous convenience, and poll hangup notification expecting drainage.

Sleep management links waiters to queues while recording desired task state, with variants reporting prior emptiness for exclusive sleep, detaching with restart indication on pending signals, restoring running state on completion, initializing entries bound to current context with autoremove wake behavior, and single interruptible sleep with lock release across descheduling.

Coordinated woken signalling allows a waiter to skip sleeping when a woken marker or stop request is present and to clear the marker with ordered semantics after waking, while wakers set the marker under ordering guarantees before default handling, and autoremove handling detaches only on successful wake.

Bit addressed waiting resolves a word plus bit to a shared queue and either waits until the bit clears while invoking caller action or acquires the bit as a lock through exclusive sleep plus atomic transition, with out of line forms supplying queue resolution and optional deadline, a dedicated wake entry for bit addresses, and small actions for plain sleep and input output sleep and deadline bounded sleep.

Bit and variable wake filtering accepts notification only on key identity match over address reference and bit identifier, with bit wake additionally requiring observed clear state, and variable entries bind current context with supplied markers and a sentinel bit identity for address only comparison.

Insertion mode governs marker handling with plain insertion clearing exclusivity and exclusive insertion setting exclusivity and priority insertion setting priority and combined insertion setting both.
Exclusive waiters use tail placement while other waiters use head placement, and event preparation preserves this choice according to the waiter exclusivity marker.
Repeated preparation is idempotent for membership with insertion only when the waiter node is detached, so reentry while queued only refreshes task state.
Pending signals abort sleep establishment with restart indication and ensure detachment, while bit sleep actions report interruption when signal pending is observed.
Bit waiting continues while the indicated bit remains observed set without action error, and bit lock waiting succeeds only by winning the atomic transition from clear to set.

Wake filtering requires equality of stored and incoming identity on address reference and bit identifier, with bit wake additionally requiring observed clear state, otherwise declining without waking.
Shared queue selection shifts the word address by five positions on thirty two bit words and six otherwise before mixing with the bit number and hashing into table range.
Domain repartitioning is serialized by holding the domains mutex across the locked update.

List membership changes and associated marker updates occur while holding the head lock with interrupt state preserved, covering insertion and removal and sleep preparation and event preparation and teardown.
Conditional priority exclusive insertion holds the head lock across the lead priority check and the admission decision so refusal is atomic with queue state.
Wake handling separates caller locked forms requiring the head lock already held from lock acquiring forms managing the lock internally for current CPU and synchronous notifications.
Interruptible single sleep does not retain the head lock across descheduling, releasing with plain or interrupt enabled semantics and reacquiring with matching semantics afterwards.
A wait queue head pairs a spin lock for membership synchronization with a list anchor for waiter nodes, initialized as an empty protected queue.

A wait queue entry carries marker flags plus a private waiting context reference plus a wake callback plus a list node, with default setup binding the private reference to current execution and selecting autoremove behavior.

A bit queue entry embeds a standard wait entry plus a key with a flags word reference and a bit identifier and for deadline waits an expiry instant, with variable form using a sentinel bit identity for address only matching.
Bit waiting multiplexes many distinct words onto a fixed global array of wait queue heads selected by hashing a shifted address mixed with bit number.
A waiter cycles from detached to queued with recorded sleep state and back to detached running state on completion, with completion restoring running state before conditional detachment.

The woken coordination ensures either the sleeper observes the marker and avoids sleeping or the waker observes sleep state, with the sleeper clearing the marker under ordered semantics after waking and wakers setting it under a barrier.
Autoremove behavior retains the waiter through unsuccessful wake attempts and detaches exactly once on successful default handling, with bit and variable handlers delegating after filtering.
Bit lock waiting repeats exclusive sleep with conditional action while contended and atomic acquire attempts until the waiter wins the set transition or receives an action error.
Out of line bit wait entries resolve the shared queue for a word and bit and establish a keyed waiter with optional deadline before delegating to the internal wait or lock loop.
Convenience wake entries cover poll hangup with drainage expectation and unkeyed synchronous wake and current CPU wake and bit addressed wake through shared queue resolution.
The poll hangup path warns when the queue remains active after notification, signalling a waiter leak retaining hangup interest.
Priority exclusive insertion reports busy when a nonempty queue is already led by a priority waiter, requiring callers to handle contention rather than assume admission.
Completion relies on careful emptiness observation outside the lock paired with exclusive locked mutation elsewhere, and violating that pairing risks lifetime errors for stack waiters.
Lock acquiring synchronous keyed wake tolerates absent heads by returning silently, whereas caller locked forms require a valid head.
Deadline bounded bit sleep reports an again condition after reaching computed expiry, distinct from interruption and successful wake.
The bit wait hash width is 8.
The bit wait table entry count is one shifted left by the hash width, namely 256.
Variable wait keys use negative one as bit identifier for address only matching.
